properties.label: Manifesto with opposing name belts
properties.text: Place a spacious left-aligned manifesto above two opposing belts of compact compatibility names that extend toward the edges through quiet fade masks.

properties.label: Comfortable compatibility labels
properties.text: Use comfortable sans typography and crisp small symbols so every compatibility name remains easy to read.

properties.label: Almost-white graphite shell
properties.text: Use an almost-white ground, graphite text and white chips with very fine neutral borders.

properties.label: Tangible bordered name chips
properties.text: Give the pill-shaped chips fine borders and soft shadows without turning the surface into a wall of logos.

properties.label: Seamless modest name belts
properties.text: Move the belts at a steady modest speed using seamless duplication and quiet edge fades.

properties.label: Pausable wrapped fallback
properties.text: Pause movement on hover, focus or an explicit action; under reduced motion show a readable wrapped set of unique items and hide visual duplicates from assistive technology.

properties.label: Truthful integration inventory
properties.text: Include only integrations that are actually supported.

properties.label: Complete marquee acceptance
properties.text: Verify both loop seams and preserve every unique agent name in the static mobile arrangement.
